title: The Charcoal Burners
text: Charcoal burners tend their smoking mounds in a clearing, black to the elbows, coughing. The trees around them are dead. They watch you come with red-rimmed eyes and hands on their axes. They do not like strangers, and they like nobles less.

options.label: Help them tend the smoking mounds.

outcomes.text: Smoky, choking work, and at the end they share their supper, and their charcoal.

options.label: The best talker wins them over.

outcomes.text: They tell you which paths the wood keeps, and which it lets go.
Their eyes follow you out of the clearing, and their smoke follows you further. Everyone is coughing by dusk.
